description: TWO MODELS TOTAL: two debaters over 2 rounds (up to 1 extra round on the judge's request), with one debater's model reused as the judge in a separate fresh session. The cheapest useful roster, and the only one that needs just two model vendors -- reach for it when Codex is unavailable or when the debate transcript matters more than the verdict. The trade-off is explicit: because the judge reuses one debater's model, it is session-independent but NOT model-independent and may systematically favour that participant's plan. The driver prints that warning (naming the shared model) on every run. Use rosters/trio.json when the verdict itself is the deliverable and must be defensible. Labels shown in prompts are deliberately anonymous ('Participant A/B'): no participant, and no judge, is TOLD which model wrote which plan in the prompt text it receives.
